panel.title: Minimized windows
panel.hint: Click a window to restore it

restore_to.label: Restore to
restore_to.description: Where a window goes when restored

restore_on_focus.label: Restore when focused
restore_on_focus.description: Restore a minimized window when it is focused from outside, for example from the window switcher, instead of showing the special workspace

mode.label: Display
mode.description: Row of windows or a single button with a menu

max_items.label: Windows shown
max_items.description: Maximum windows in the row before a +N button appears

show_titles.description: Show the window title next to its icon

hide_when_empty.label: Hide when empty
hide_when_empty.description: Hide the widget when there are no minimized windows
